_note: The one catalogue of the website and the iOS app (served to both by GET /api/listings). Things anyone can rent: the Mystery Box of the live stage demo (stage: true; /stage/<slug>, /r/<slug>) and DEMO scooter listings (/ and /app/listings/<slug>). Edit freely: amounts in THB (rentThb per day, monthThb per month). Each listing's photos are paths of the 1200 px JPEG of a real photo under web/public/listings/photos (<name>-{480,960,1200}.{avif,webp,jpg}, 4:3); `photos` below holds each one's size, alt text and credit (Wikimedia Commons; CC0, CC BY or CC BY-SA only), listed on /credits. The scooters are not real shops' offers and the photos show the model, not the listed scooter. thbPerUsdt is the fixed demo rate used to price these rentals in mUSDT (stable between the test-money drip and the rental).

listings.name: Honda Click 125i
listings.description: Demo listing. The everyday automatic of northern Thailand: light, easy to park and enough for the road up Doi Suthep.

listings.name: Yamaha NMAX 155
listings.description: Demo listing. A roomy maxi-scooter for two with luggage, comfortable on the coast road between the beaches.

listings.name: Vespa Primavera 150
listings.description: Demo listing. The classic steel-body Vespa for short city hops between cafes, markets and the skytrain.

listings.name: Honda PCX 160
listings.description: Demo listing. Smooth and quiet, with room under the seat for two helmets. Good for a week around the island.

listings.name: Honda Scoopy
listings.description: Demo listing. Small, light and friendly: the scooter most first-time riders pick for the valley roads around Pai.

listings.name: Yamaha Grand Filano
listings.description: Demo listing. An easy, elegant commuter with a flat floor, made for the lanes inside the old city moat.

listings.name: Yamaha Fino 125
listings.description: Demo listing. A light, retro-styled automatic that slips through the side streets of Silom and parks anywhere.

listings.name: KeyEscrow Mystery Box
listings.description: A real box we brought to the stage. Rent it, take it, bring it back: the deposit sits in its own escrow on BNB Chain until both sides agree.
